issues.title: [arken-space] Add player achievement collection and GM achievement builder
issues.originalDescription:
## Context

Low-priority product idea: a personal collection of achievements for platform actions and memorable play situations. Examples: Ираклий — «Первопроходец», «Багфиксер». The GM should be able to assemble an achievement from an approved game-art pack, choose its colour and caption, then award it to selected players.

## Task

Design and implement an achievements domain, GM builder and player-profile showcase.

## Acceptance Criteria

* GM can create, edit, archive and award an achievement to one or more players.
* An achievement supports approved icon/asset reference, colour, title, optional description and provenance.
* Player profile displays only achievements that are visible to that player/audience.
* Award/revoke events are auditable and do not leak GM-only context.
* Reuse of game-pack media respects the existing asset ACL and lifecycle rules.
* UI supports the two initial example achievements without hard-coding them.
* Authorization, persistence and visibility tests cover GM, owner and other players.

## Suggested Next Action

Define visibility and asset-selection rules, then prototype a small achievement-card model before implementation.

issues.title: Сделать WebAR-просмотр обложки «Рубиновый орден» на arken-khar.space
issues.originalDescription:
## Цель

Добавить на сайт [https://arken-khar.space/](<https://arken-khar.space/>) отдельную мобильную WebAR-страницу для книги **«Рубиновый орден»**. Пользователь должен иметь возможность открыть страницу на телефоне, дать доступ к камере, навести её на физическую обложку книги и увидеть поверх неё цветную анимированную AR-версию.

Первый этап — реализовать и проверить механику на обложке. После успешного MVP использовать тот же подход для других иллюстраций внутри книги.

## Концепция

В печатной книге иллюстрации могут оставаться **чёрно-белыми**, а при наведении камеры через AR поверх них должны появляться **цветные анимированные версии**.

Пример пользовательского сценария:

1. Пользователь открывает отдельную AR-страницу на [arken-khar.space](<http://arken-khar.space>) с телефона.
2. Страница объясняет, что нужно разрешить доступ к камере и навести её на обложку.
3. Пользователь запускает AR.
4. Камера распознаёт обложку «Рубиновый орден» как image target.
5. Поверх печатной обложки появляется привязанная к ней цветная анимация / визуальные эффекты.
6. При движении телефона AR-контент сохраняет положение и перспективу относительно книги.

## MVP — обложка «Рубиновый орден»

* Создать отдельную страницу на сайте для AR-просмотра.
* Сделать mobile-first интерфейс.
* Запрашивать доступ к камере только после понятного действия пользователя.
* Настроить распознавание изображения обложки как AR-маркера / image target.
* Отображать поверх неё цветную анимированную версию обложки.
* Проверить стабильность трекинга при небольших наклонах, изменении расстояния и освещения.
* Добавить состояния интерфейса: ожидание запуска, запрос камеры, поиск обложки, обложка найдена, ошибка/нет доступа к камере.
* Предусмотреть кнопку выхода/перезапуска AR.
* Проверить работу на актуальных Android и iPhone.

## Техническое направление

Для первого прототипа рассмотреть WebAR без обязательной установки приложения:

* image tracking через **MindAR** или аналог;
* рендеринг через **Three.js/WebGL**;
* AR-контент может быть 2D-анимацией, видео/последовательностью кадров, WebGL-анимацией или 3D — выбрать самый производительный вариант для конкретной иллюстрации;
* ассеты и логика конкретной иллюстрации должны быть отделены от общего AR-движка.

Не завязывать реализацию только на одну обложку: структура должна позволять добавлять новые image targets и соответствующие им AR-сцены без переписывания всей страницы.

## Второй этап — AR-иллюстрации книги

После успешной работы обложки подготовить механизм для внутренних иллюстраций:

* печатная версия изображения — чёрно-белая;
* камера распознаёт конкретную иллюстрацию;
* поверх неё появляется совмещённая **цветная версия**;
* цветная версия может быть анимирована: движение персонажей, свет, магия, дым, частицы, окружение и т.п.;
* предусмотреть возможность нескольких разных иллюстраций в одной книге;
* продумать способ удобно добавлять новые иллюстрации и AR-ассеты в будущем.

## Критерии готовности MVP

* На [arken-khar.space](<http://arken-khar.space>) существует отдельная AR-страница.
* Она открывается с телефона без установки приложения.
* Пользователь может дать доступ к камере.
* Обложка «Рубиновый орден» стабильно распознаётся.
* Цветной анимированный контент визуально привязан к печатной обложке.
* После успешного прототипа понятно, как тем же механизмом подключать другие иллюстрации книги.

issues.title: [arken-space] Manual QA checklist — накопительный список для ручного тестирования
issues.originalDescription:
## Context

Живой чек-лист изменений, которые задеплоены на прод в рамках текущей сессии работы и требуют ручной проверки Andrey. Пополняется по мере деплоя новых фиксов — не закрывать, пока не протестировано всё целиком.

## Проверить

### Линейка (ruler)

- [ ] Протянуть линейку, отпустить — дистанция показывается в клетках сетки ("N кл." / "N px без сетки" вне сетки).
- [ ] На дальнем конце линейки видна стрелка.
- [ ] Протянуть линейку → переключить инструмент кнопкой → линия пропадает у всех участников.
- [ ] Протянуть линейку → нажать Esc → линия корректно пропадает (не остаётся висеть на карте).

### Рисование (DRAW)

- [ ] Быстро потаскать слайдер толщины линии — ошибок "Не удалось выполнить действие" быть не должно.
- [ ] Сменить цвет через палитру и через color-picker — без ошибок.
- [ ] Нарисовать линию — не должно быть заметной задержки/пропадания линии после отпускания кнопки мыши.
- [ ] Начать рисовать → нажать Esc посреди штриха → штрих должен отмениться (не оставаться и не "выпрыгивать" при следующем включении DRAW).

### Видимость слоёв

- [ ] Не-GM роль не видит GM-слой токенов.
- [ ] Токены с `visible=false` на MAP-слое не видны игрокам, только GM.

### Fog (туман войны)

- [ ] REVEAL/COVER применяются в правильном порядке при перекрытии операций.
- [ ] BRUSH-инструмент fog работает (circular brush). POLYGON пока не реализован — ожидаемо недоступен.

### Домен и инфраструктура

- [ ] Логин и вся функциональность работают через `arken-khar.space`.
- [ ] Старые ссылки на `arken.uixray.tech` корректно редиректят на новый домен.
- [ ] 6 личных страничек игроков открываются (archinamon/irakly123/daryasteel/veepeek/zheludock/uixray.arken-khar.space).

### Прочее

### Operator feedback inbox (<issue id="450acb54-0cdf-4911-bec2-95443a07b8ac" href="https://linear.app/uixraydesign/issue/UIX-318/arken-space-add-secure-operator-feedback-inbox-and-restore-trusted">UIX-318</issue>)

- [ ] Зайти под GM-аккаунтом — в Sidebar должен быть доступен инбокс фидбэка.
- [ ] С player-аккаунта (любого из 6 игроков) инбокс НЕ должен быть виден/доступен.
- [ ] Открыть отчёт, проверить reveal/скрытие контактных данных по умолчанию, смену триаж-статуса.
- [ ] Вкладка "Личные" (direct messages) скрыта из чат-панели (<issue id="0dcb7e14-63a2-4d4c-958a-721ba78a0cc5" href="https://linear.app/uixraydesign/issue/UIX-365/arken-space-redesign-direct-messages-mechanic-before-re-enabling">UIX-365</issue>, до редизайна).

### <issue id="dc11889c-ff75-4d84-b7d9-e01c381e1c17" href="https://linear.app/uixraydesign/issue/UIX-363/arken-space-improve-chattoken-ux-paste-images-draggable-dice-panel">UIX-363</issue> — пул UX-правок

- [ ] Ctrl+V и Cmd+V вставляют картинку из буфера обмена в личный чат; вставка текста работает как раньше.
- [ ] Перетащить токен из трея на карту под GM — работает.
- [ ] То же под игроком с правами на токен — работает; без прав — перетаскивание недоступно.
- [ ] GM может создать персонажа "на основе" существующего — статы/навыки/инвентарь переносятся, имя/портрет/заметки — нет; изменения нового персонажа не влияют на исходный. Недоступно игрокам.
- [ ] Панель быстрых бросков костей перетаскивается за ручку-грип, остаётся в границах экрана, кнопка сброса позиции работает; сами броски костей работают как раньше.

### <issue id="118b00ac-6330-48db-ac13-343bf5aff2b3" href="https://linear.app/uixraydesign/issue/UIX-292/arken-space-add-character-sheet-media-galleries-and-illustrated">UIX-292</issue> — медиагалерея персонажа

- [ ] Игрок загружает картинки в галерею своего персонажа (портрет при этом не ломается).
- [ ] Открытие в full-size просмотрщике, навигация стрелками/Esc работает.
- [ ] Смена категории/подписи/порядка работают без ошибок.
- [ ] "Убрать из галереи" (detach) доступно владельцу; файл при этом не удаляется физически.
- [ ] Только GM видит кнопку "Удалить навсегда" и может её использовать — у владельца её нет.
- [ ] GM может зайти на ЛЮБОй лист персонажа (не только свой) и управлять его галереей, включая GM-only материалы, которые владелец не видит.
- [ ] Игрок-контроллер (без владения) НЕ видит кнопок редактирования галереи чужого персонажа.

### Бой с карты/региона (<issue id="cd038783-025b-43e0-9ef3-eda09ac167a5" href="https://linear.app/uixraydesign/issue/UIX-311/arken-space-start-encounters-from-map-regions-or-linked-tactical">UIX-311</issue>)

- [ ] GM: кнопка «Начать бой» на тактической карте → «Выделить область текущей сцены» → выделить прямоугольник на карте → подтвердить — камера всех участников фокусируется на выделенной области.
- [ ] «Завершить бой» после SCENE_REGION — камера возвращается к обзору всей сцены.
- [ ] GM: «Начать бой» → «Перейти в другую локацию» → выбрать локацию со связанной сценой → видно preflight-предупреждение, если у игрока нет токена на целевой сцене.
- [ ] После подтверждения LINKED_SCENE — все игроки переключаются на целевую сцену одновременно, токены игроков перенеслись на относительно ту же позицию, что была на исходной сцене.
- [ ] «Завершить бой» после LINKED_SCENE — игроки НЕ возвращаются на исходную сцену автоматически.
- [ ] То же через «Начать бой» в рабочем пространстве карты мира (только LINKED_SCENE там должен быть доступен, не SCENE_REGION).
- [ ] Игрок не видит кнопки «Начать/Завершить бой» вообще.

## Suggested Next Action

Прогнать целиком одним заходом, отметить проваленные пункты — заведём отдельные баги под каждый провал.

issues.title: [arken-space] Add reusable terrain stamp brushes for scene drawing
issues.originalDescription:
## Context

A playtester proposed extending freehand scene drawing with reusable stamp brushes for quickly marking terrain and atmospheric features such as forests, mountains and clouds.

Existing <issue id="78eec3e2-e776-4f6d-8229-8bfb029d8615" href="https://linear.app/uixraydesign/issue/UIX-214/arken-space-persistent-drawings-shared-ruler-and-map-navigation">UIX-214</issue> covers persistent freehand drawings, while <issue id="29123a34-ca28-4352-b0c3-8aa333691d19" href="https://linear.app/uixraydesign/issue/UIX-313/arken-space-add-circular-brush-and-polygon-tools-for-ordered-fog">UIX-313</issue> covers fog brush geometry. Neither covers reusable decorative map stamps.

## Task

Research and add a GM-facing stamp-brush tool for placing approved reusable terrain/decorative symbols on a scene.

## Acceptance Criteria

* Stamp brushes are a separate drawing mode and cannot accidentally modify fog.
* GM can select a stamp from a curated palette, preview placement, set size and rotation, and place repeated instances efficiently.
* MVP includes representative forest, mountain and cloud stamps or an equivalent test pack.
* Placed stamps are persistent server-authoritative scene objects with stable IDs, author, transform, layer and revision.
* Stamps participate in selection, area selection, move, copy, delete, undo and redo.
* Visibility/layer rules are explicit; PLAYER cannot access hidden GM-only stamps or their assets.
* Asset delivery does not preload hidden stamp packs for unauthorized clients.
* Dense stamping has documented batching, payload and renderer-performance limits.
* Pointer, keyboard and touch behavior is compatible with the shared interaction-command architecture.
* Tests cover permissions, persistence, reconnect, undo/redo, repeated placement and large stamp counts.

## Links

* Linear: <issue id="78eec3e2-e776-4f6d-8229-8bfb029d8615" href="https://linear.app/uixraydesign/issue/UIX-214/arken-space-persistent-drawings-shared-ruler-and-map-navigation">UIX-214</issue>, <issue id="0852b40a-9532-4e97-99da-5f51a5320558" href="https://linear.app/uixraydesign/issue/UIX-212/arken-space-authoritative-canvas-undo-and-redo">UIX-212</issue>, <issue id="e68d4b95-7685-452c-afeb-e553834868ec" href="https://linear.app/uixraydesign/issue/UIX-213/arken-space-canvas-visibility-layers-and-ordered-fog-operations">UIX-213</issue>, <issue id="01b272e6-821f-4bdc-8c67-4609669a4f0b" href="https://linear.app/uixraydesign/issue/UIX-256/arken-space-build-map-interaction-command-core-and-keyboard-access">UIX-256</issue>
* Source: production feedback inbox, 2026-07-28

## Open Questions

* Curated built-in pack only, or later support for GM-uploaded stamp packs.
* Whether stamps should snap to grid, allow free placement, or support both.
* Whether repeated placement is individual objects or a batched stamp stroke.

## Suggested Next Action

Prototype the data model and renderer performance with one curated pack and 100–500 placed stamps before designing pack management.

issues.title: [arken-space] Render fully opaque animated cloud texture over fog
issues.originalDescription:
## Context

The current covered fog is a flat near-black fill. The GM wants a more atmospheric treatment: slowly shifting dark clouds while the covered area remains fully opaque.

This is decorative only. It must never reveal covered map pixels or change authoritative fog geometry.

## Task

Add a performance-safe animated cloud texture clipped by the existing binary fog mask, with static and reduced-motion fallbacks.

## Rendering Decision

For MVP, keep the current Konva/Canvas2D renderer. Do not introduce a second WebGL renderer or shader pipeline before profiling.

Separate:

1. authoritative binary coverage mask;
2. decorative cloud texture rendered only inside covered pixels.

Always keep a solid opaque base beneath the texture. Player fog opacity is forced to 1.

## Acceptance Criteria

* Covered player pixels remain fully opaque regardless of cloud animation frame, texture alpha or blending.
* REVEAL/COVER geometry and hit/visibility behavior are unchanged.
* Cloud texture is clipped to covered fog and never becomes the coverage mask itself.
* Boundary rendering has no transparent pinholes; pixel tests confirm covered alpha remains 255.
* GM preview opacity remains separate and cannot alter PLAYER opacity.
* Animation pauses when document is hidden and uses a static fallback for reduced motion and low-power mode.
* Animation frame rate and resolution are capped; mask geometry/cache is not rebuilt every animation frame.
* Long sessions, large scenes and many fog operations remain responsive.
* Missing texture or rendering failure falls back to the current solid fog.
* No hidden map data is sampled to generate the cloud texture.
* Browser QA covers reload, reconnect, zoom/pan, resize, supported narrow viewports and different DPR values.
* Tests include deterministic mask composition, opaque pixel assertions, reduced-motion fallback and performance budget.

## Risks

* A WebGL shader would require a separate context, transform synchronization, resize/DPR handling and context-loss recovery.
* Animated APNG/GIF is harder to pause and control; a small procedural/offscreen Canvas2D texture is preferred initially.
* Current fog is visual rather than a complete asset-secrecy boundary; this task must not be presented as security hardening.

## Delivery Plan

1. Produce/approve a seamless dark cloud texture or procedural prototype.
2. Build cached binary mask + independent decorative layer.
3. Add reduced-motion/visibility/performance controls.
4. Pixel and browser QA.
5. Consider a shader only after measured Canvas2D limitations.

## Links

* <issue id="e68d4b95-7685-452c-afeb-e553834868ec" href="https://linear.app/uixraydesign/issue/UIX-213/arken-space-canvas-visibility-layers-and-ordered-fog-operations">UIX-213</issue> — fog mask and ordered operations.

## Suggested Next Action

Prototype one low-resolution Canvas2D cloud layer over a fixed opaque mask and measure frame time/memory before selecting final art or WebGL.

issues.title: [arken-space] Prototype a safe bidirectional Telegram bridge for story chat and dice
issues.originalDescription:
## Context

<issue id="aeab072f-89d7-4922-8d63-efbadde72e74" href="https://linear.app/uixraydesign/issue/UIX-246/arken-space-build-gm-story-channel-with-narrative-media-and-safe">UIX-246</issue> delivered the GM STORY channel and safe local-export importer. A permitted Telegram Desktop export is now available at `D:\User\Downloads\Telegram Desktop\ChatExport_2026-07-24` (127 records, 102 JPG; technically suitable for the first review-first import).

The next product question is whether new service messages can be mirrored to Telegram, Telegram messages mirrored back into the service, and dice commands issued in Telegram with canonical results displayed in both places.

## Task

Design and implement a limited, campaign-scoped Telegram Bot API bridge after the real export dry-run succeeds. Keep arken-space as the canonical source for authorization, dice evaluation and persisted events.

## Acceptance Criteria

* A GM explicitly links one Telegram chat/thread to one campaign using a short-lived, single-use token; arbitrary chats cannot attach themselves.
* Telegram webhook requests are authenticated and updates are durably deduplicated by Telegram update/message identifiers.
* Service STORY publication can mirror supported text/images to the linked Telegram destination without exposing drafts, GM notes, provenance or hidden attachments.
* Supported Telegram messages can enter a review queue or configured published flow with explicit author mapping and rights status; unknown users are rejected or quarantined.
* Echo loops are prevented using a persisted internal↔Telegram message mapping and origin marker.
* `/roll` commands use the server's existing canonical dice pipeline; one roll is persisted once and the same result is rendered in the service and Telegram.
* Retries are idempotent; partial media failures are visible and recoverable.
* Token, chat ID and webhook secret are stored as secrets/private configuration and never sent in player payloads or logs.
* Rate limits, media type/size validation, edit/delete policy, audit log and unlink/kill switch are defined and tested.
* The first release is limited to a test bot and test campaign; production activation requires a separate explicit gate.

## Delivery Plan

1. Run <issue id="aeab072f-89d7-4922-8d63-efbadde72e74" href="https://linear.app/uixraydesign/issue/UIX-246/arken-space-build-gm-story-channel-with-narrative-media-and-safe">UIX-246</issue> importer in dry-run mode against the supplied local JSON export and review the report.
2. Import an approved small batch as DRAFT and verify media/provenance/idempotency.
3. Add campaign↔Telegram connection model and webhook ingestion behind a feature flag.
4. Add one-way service→Telegram STORY mirroring.
5. Add Telegram→service review queue.
6. Add `/roll` using the existing server-authoritative roll path.
7. Run security, retry, echo-loop and multiplayer/realtime QA.

## Related

* <issue id="aeab072f-89d7-4922-8d63-efbadde72e74" href="https://linear.app/uixraydesign/issue/UIX-246/arken-space-build-gm-story-channel-with-narrative-media-and-safe">UIX-246</issue> — GM story channel and safe archive import.
* <issue id="04924bd9-93f6-4d05-a23f-af6b4da0b036" href="https://linear.app/uixraydesign/issue/UIX-245/arken-space-build-world-encyclopedia-and-campaign-chronicles">UIX-245</issue> — world encyclopedia and chronicles.

## Open Questions

* Telegram destination: existing public channel, linked discussion group/topic, or a separate private group?
* Should ordinary Telegram messages become DRAFT by default, while `/roll` is published immediately?
* Which Telegram accounts map to the GM and player identities?
* How should edits/deletes in either system propagate after publication?

issues.title: [arken-space] Design regional economy and server-authoritative shops
issues.originalDescription:
## Context

Future important feature: shops and markets whose prices depend on region, buyer charisma, season and other authored factors.

This is deliberately deferred until canonical items, item instances, inventory, currency and a world calendar exist.

## Task

Design a server-authoritative regional economy and merchant transaction system with explainable price composition.

## Dependencies

* canonical ITEM entities and campaign item instances;
* structured character inventory and currency;
* location/region model;
* calendar with year/month/season;
* server-authoritative character stats and authorization.

## Acceptance Criteria

* Item templates have a base price and currency/unit.
* Markets/merchants define region, stock and applicable pricing rules.
* Price quotes are calculated server-side from base price plus explicit region, season, merchant, supply, buyer-charisma and GM modifiers.
* Every quote records the input revision, applied factors, rounding and final price.
* Quote expiry/revalidation prevents buying against stale stock, wallet or rules.
* Purchase atomically updates wallet, stock, inventory and transaction history.
* Repeated action IDs cannot duplicate a purchase.
* Player cannot substitute another character, charisma value, region, season or price.
* GM may override a price only with a recorded reason.
* Hidden stock and GM pricing rules are filtered server-side.
* Tests cover concurrent purchase, insufficient funds, stale quote, seasonal change, charisma modifier, rollback and authorization.

## Out of scope for first implementation

* autonomous economy simulation;
* dynamic AI merchants;
* automatic balancing of canonical prices.

## Suggested Next Action

Leave in backlog until item instances and calendar contracts are approved.

issues.title: [arken-space] Build GM world-entity and campaign-instance manager
issues.originalDescription:
## Context

The GM needs a practical manager for canonical locations, people, monsters, deities, factions and items, plus campaign-specific appearances and overrides.

## Task

Build the GM editing workspace on top of the canonical World Content model. Keep reusable lore separate from mutable campaign instances.

## Acceptance Criteria

* GM can create, edit, version, archive and relate canonical MVP entity types.
* Entities support aliases, type/subtype, tags, public summary/text, GM-only text, cover and ordered gallery.
* Canonical location/person/monster/item records can be referenced from multiple campaigns.
* Campaign instances can override display name, current state, GM notes, portrait/token, owner and current location without changing canon.
* One canonical NPC/monster can have multiple independent campaign instances.
* Item instances support at least quantity, owner/container and condition; pricing is explicitly out of scope.
* Location entities link to world-map nodes and zero or more local scenes.
* Revisions/CAS prevent silent overwrite; operations are idempotent and audited.
* Deleting an entity used by maps, chronicles or campaigns is rejected or converted to an explicit archive flow.
* Player APIs never expose drafts, GM fields, hidden relations or private media.
* Browser verification covers create/edit/link/archive and player-safe projection.

## Suggested Next Action

Approve the canonical-vs-instance boundary and minimal field matrix for each entity type.

issues.title: [arken-space] Import and reconcile Tilda, Framer and Eagle world content
issues.originalDescription:
## Context

World content exists across a newer Tilda site, a legacy Framer artbook and a high-resolution Eagle library folder (MLYAKGQP92JYD). Sources may conflict and web images may be derivatives rather than originals.

## Task

Build a review-first import registry and migration pipeline. Inventory entities/media, match duplicates, preserve provenance, and create draft world-content records without silently choosing canon.

## Acceptance Criteria

* Tilda, Framer and Eagle records retain stable external IDs/URLs, retrieval date and raw checksum.
* Source priority is provisional: Tilda newer > Framer legacy; every field conflict enters a review queue.
* Eagle originals are matched by ID/checksum/curated mapping rather than filename alone.
* Each asset stores attribution, rights-review status and relation to original/derivative variants.
* Re-import is idempotent and never creates duplicate entities or media.

* The system stores spell progression as a validated directed graph supporting forks and converging prerequisites.

issues.title: [arken-space] Build world encyclopedia and campaign chronicles
issues.originalDescription:
## Context

Даша предложила интегрировать энциклопедию мира. The GM later supplied three source layers:

1. [https://arken-khar.tilda.ws/](<https://arken-khar.tilda.ws/>) — newer editorial source and provisional precedence;
2. [https://arc.framer.photos/](<https://arc.framer.photos/>) — legacy public artbook/reference;
3. Eagle folder MLYAKGQP92JYD — high-quality media originals and asset inventory.

The legacy Framer artbook contains card-like Pantheon, Locations, Characters and Creatures sections. It is useful as migration input but must not be treated as current canon when Tilda differs.

The product needs two connected but distinct experiences:

* a player-facing world encyclopedia presented as chronicles, notes and interconnected lore;
* a GM-facing manager for locations, people, monsters, items and other world entities.

## Architectural boundary

Create a canonical **World Content** layer independent from campaign-scoped characters/scenes/assets/catalog entries.

Campaigns reference canonical entities and add:

* discovered/visible state;
* campaign-specific overrides and secrets;
* NPC/monster/item instances;
* location/scene appearances;
* chronicle entries tied to campaign time.

Do not overload the existing SKILL/ABILITY catalog or technical game_events as encyclopedia content.

## Task

Define and deliver the world-content foundation, player-safe encyclopedia and campaign chronicle experience.

## Core entity types

* LOCATION
* PERSON
* MONSTER
* DEITY
* FACTION
* ITEM
* ARTICLE

Each entity needs a stable ID/slug, type/subtype, aliases, summary, rich public text, GM-only text, tags, relations, lifecycle, revision, provenance, cover and ordered gallery.

## Chronicle model

* authored entry with title/body;
* game-world timestamp/era;
* author and publication state;
* player/GM visibility;
* links to world entities, maps, scenes and media;
* optional technical game event as a private source reference, never raw player-facing content.

## Acceptance Criteria

* World content survives campaign deletion and can be reused across campaigns.
* GM can manage MVP entity types, relations, tags, covers and galleries.
* Player encyclopedia exposes only PUBLISHED or campaign-discovered content.
* GM-only names, text, relations, drafts and media cannot be discovered through search, API, snapshot, DOM or direct asset URLs.
* Search and filtering cover type, tags, region/era and known relations.
* Stable entity pages show connected locations, people, creatures and articles.
* Chronicle entries sort by game-world time rather than server creation time.
* GM can author/edit/publish chronicle entries and attach entity/media references.
* A technical game event can seed a chronicle draft but its raw payload is never published.
* Canonical entities and campaign instances are distinct; campaign overrides never silently rewrite canon.
* Location entities integrate with <issue id="7d03f894-387a-4eb4-8e51-40fa73d7aa3a" href="https://linear.app/uixraydesign/issue/UIX-243/arken-space-add-hierarchical-world-maps-party-position-and-explicit">UIX-243</issue> map nodes without duplicating descriptions or images.
* Revision/CAS, idempotent action IDs and audit history protect edits.
* Accessibility, desktop/narrow layouts and player/GM browser flows are verified.

## Source and editorial policy

* Tilda is provisional newer source precedence.
* Framer is legacy/reference and requires reconciliation.
* Eagle is the preferred high-resolution media source when a matching original exists.
* Conflicts create a review item; no source silently overwrites another.
* Every imported record preserves source URL/external ID, retrieval date, raw hash, attribution, rights-review status and editorial approval.
* Imports create DRAFT records only.

## Delivery Plan

1. Inventory Tilda, Framer and Eagle sources; define conflicts and rights policy.
2. Implement canonical world entity/media/relation foundation.
3. Build GM entity manager and review queue.
4. Build player-safe encyclopedia and search.
5. Add campaign discovery/overrides and instances.
6. Add chronicles and event-to-draft flow.
7. Integrate locations with maps/scenes.
8. Verify privacy, provenance, persistence and migrations.

## Links

* Newer source: [https://arken-khar.tilda.ws/](<https://arken-khar.tilda.ws/>)
* Legacy artbook: [https://arc.framer.photos/](<https://arc.framer.photos/>)
* Eagle source folder: MLYAKGQP92JYD
* Related: <issue id="7d03f894-387a-4eb4-8e51-40fa73d7aa3a" href="https://linear.app/uixraydesign/issue/UIX-243/arken-space-add-hierarchical-world-maps-party-position-and-explicit">UIX-243</issue> — world maps and locations.
* Related: <issue id="aeab072f-89d7-4922-8d63-efbadde72e74" href="https://linear.app/uixraydesign/issue/UIX-246/arken-space-research-telegram-archive-import-and-narrative-chat-media">UIX-246</issue> — narrative archive research.

## Open Questions

* Establish a canonical calendar/era model for chronicle ordering.
* Approve original-vs-derived asset storage policy before importing Eagle masters.
* Confirm publication/licensing policy for MidJourney art and credited authored text.

## Suggested Next Action

Complete a source inventory and conflict matrix, then approve the canonical world entity and media provenance contracts before importing any content.

issues.title: [arken-space] Full product GM + 6 acceptance rehearsal
issues.originalDescription:
## Context

The foundation received a shortened rehearsal. Full readiness is deferred until the approved backlog is implemented.

## Task

Run the complete product gate with one GM and six independent player profiles.

## Acceptance Criteria

* Fresh verified backup and tested migration/reset evidence exist first.
* Automated unit/integration/browser/GM+6/recovery gates pass at deployed revision.
* A 30–45 minute rehearsal covers access, characters/catalog/rolls, currency, canvas, undo/redo, tokens, chat, presence and music.
* Chrome, Firefox and Edge are represented.
* Adversarial checks show no cross-player mutation or GM-layer leak.
* Defects include reproduction, expected/actual, revision and action/request IDs.
* Readiness requires blockers fixed and rerun.

## Delivery Pipeline

1. Prepare campaign/profiles.
2. Run automated gates.
3. Run human rehearsal.
4. Fix blockers/repeat.
5. Record go/no-go.

## Prompt

```text
Perform final arken-space acceptance after prerequisites complete. Verify deployed revision with one GM and six clean profiles, exercise the approved backlog, record evidence/defects, and do not mark ready with any security, persistence or game-blocking defect.
```
